name: Sentry
summary: 查询 Sentry 项目、Issue、事件与错误趋势。
description: Sentry 官方 MCP 服务，可查询项目、Issue、错误事件与趋势，帮助定位线上问题。OAuth 授权会按服务支持的权限申请。
examples: 查最近 24 小时的错误趋势
定位一个错误的堆栈和影响范围
总结一个项目的发布健康度

en.summary: Query Sentry projects, issues, events, and error trends.
en.description: Official Sentry MCP service for projects, issues, error events, and trends. OAuth requests the scopes the service supports.
examples: Show the error trend over the last 24 hours
Locate the stack and impact of an error
Summarize the release health of a project
